name: Lighthouse Scoring # Runs only after a successful deploy, so it always audits the real, # currently-live site rather than guessing at timing. It never fails # the build — no assertions or budgets are configured — since its job # is to report scores, not to add another required check to pass. 'on': workflow_run: workflows: ["Deploy static site to GitHub Pages"] types: [completed] jobs: lighthouse: runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }} steps: - name: Audit key pages with Lighthouse uses: treosh/lighthouse-ci-action@v12 with: urls: | https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/launch-all.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/1-ecommerce.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/9-finance-dashboard.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/5-weather.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/muster/index.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/muster/cafe.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/muster/cards.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/muster/range.html https://alexmutegi.github.io/Electroduction/muster/gym.html # Uploads each report to Lighthouse's free temporary public # storage and prints a shareable link in the job log — the # simplest way to view results from a phone, no artifact # download needed. Links expire after about 7 days. temporaryPublicStorage: true uploadArtifacts: true
